Article about me and my stock investments in the Euroinvestor magazine today (in Danish).

In the interview I talk about how I quit my job in Management Consulting to focus exclusively on managing my investment portfolio on 
eToro.

We also talk about my investment strategy and ethical investing.

The article is for Euroinvestor subscribers only.

https://www.euroinvestor.dk/ugens-topinvestor/han-sagde-sit-job-op-og-satsede-alt-paa-investering-i-dag-har-jeppe-kirk-bonde-15-milliarder-kroner-under-forvaltning

Thank you to Marie-Louise Tønder for writing the article.
